description: Change of use from a single residential dwelling (use Class C3) to an HMO for 6 persons (use Class C4) with associated works
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">DETAILS
The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details relating
to the provision of 6 240L wheelie bins in two separate storage containers has
been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details prior to
the occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</span></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 115%;">Reasonable
Exception Statement, Planning &amp; Supporting Statement,01 Location Plan, &nbsp;03 Existing site plan, 04 Existing Ground
floor plan, 05 Existing first floor plan, 06 Existing roof plan, 07 Existing
elevation plans, 08 Existing side elevations, 10 Proposed site plan, 11
Proposed Ground Floor Plans, HMO Management Plan, 12 Proposed First Floor Plans,
13 Proposed Loft Plans, 15 Proposed Elevations, 16 Proposed Side Elevations</span>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The
HMO hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than 6 no. occupants at any
given time. The development shall be operated in accordance with the hereby
approved plans at all times in perpetuity unless any substantive changes are
otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The
cycle storage facilities shall be implemented as approved on drawing number 11 –
Proposed GF.&nbsp; The cycle storage shall be
retained in thereafter in accordance with the approved details.</span></p>
